text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Winning Live following the exhibition 
race. On stage, Silence Suzuka heard the 
fans calling out, "Welcome back!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In that instant, the desire to "return 
here" welled up in her chest. She conveyed 
that feeling directly to her fans.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, while promoting the 
Grand Live, several Umamusume showed 
interest. However, one Umamusume loudly 
voiced her objection.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"A concert where anyone can sing denies 
all the effort that went into it. It's 
just running away from the inability to 
win." —A heavy silence fell over those 
words.
